MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'BV-1-1'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'P-12-2'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))
UNWIND [n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.tag IS NOT NULL | n.tag] AS tag
RETURN tag

MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'BV-1-1'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'P-12-2'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))
UNWIND range(0, size(nodes(p)) - 1) AS i
WITH nodes(p)[i] AS item, i, relationships(p) AS rels
RETURN i AS flow_order,
       item.tag AS tag,
       item.kind AS type,
       CASE WHEN i < size(rels) THEN rels[i].via_tags ELSE null END AS inline_tags
ORDER BY flow_order
